tool.token_handling: reads bearer token from an environment variable and does not serialize token values
tool.redaction_policy: message bodies, result messages, progress line text, and bearer-token request headers are excluded from the generated JSON report
tool.terminal_live_conflict_detection: reports terminal_active_stream_count and decision=captured_terminal_live_conflict when a completed/stopped/failed/cancelled/timeout thread has active_stream or a matching live SSE event

decision.summary: The reproduction is not captured here. This artifact makes the next required evidence executable so a future tester can capture same-moment API and SSE summaries without placing bearer tokens or message bodies into repo evidence. The capture tool now separates ordinary historical progress from a terminal/live conflict so the reported completed-but-still-progressing race can be identified directly when it recurs.
